verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a managed data service that also hosts embedding, reranking and assistant models, so whether customer data trains AI models is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack documents RBAC, SSO, audit logs, CMEK encryption and Private Endpoints, but nothing about a training opt-out or a no-training data-use policy. Those security controls are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
